turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day dimension (its finest time grain is the day), so I cannot say which hour had the most page views. The closest metrics are customer_actions (filtered to action type page_view) and site_sessions (sessions with a page view), both of which I can give by day, week or month for 20 September to 3 October 2026.
